start: A workout is open; Android closed MettleUp in the background

user_sees: The minimised workout bar on every tab, not only on the Workout tab
must_not: The open workout lost
A second, empty workout
A set ticked while the app was closed saved after the cards were posted from the old workout

steps.action: Lock the phone and look at the lock screen
user_sees: The live workout card that 'Shows your open workout so you can jump back in'
No sound from that card
must_not: A card for a workout that was already finished
A sound from the live workout card

user_sees: The workout screen opens on the open workout
must_not: Only the Workout tab opening
Two workout screens stacked

start: Resting between sets, phone locked, rest card on the lock screen

user_sees: The next set ticked with the numbers shown in grey on its row
The rest starts again and the card names the next set
must_not: The set ticked twice
Last session's numbers saved when today's targets were not read yet

steps.action: Tap 'Done' when the next row has nothing to save
user_sees: The app opens on that set with a note saying what to add first
With the app in the background: a quiet note 'Open it within 10 min to log this set.'
must_not: An empty set saved
No word at all about why nothing was ticked

start: App closed; a notification from the gym (a reply to a message) arrives

user_sees: The page it names opens (for a gym reply: the gym message page)
must_not: Only the app opening on its last tab
A link to another app or website opened

steps.action: Tap a gym reminder notification instead
user_sees: The Gym tab opens on its 'My gym' part
must_not: The Workout tab opening

user_sees: 'Ask a trainer' opens with the reply
must_not: A blank page

start: A Hevy or Strong export file in another app

steps.action: Use Android's share menu and pick MettleUp
user_sees: MettleUp opens on the import screen with that file
must_not: The file ignored
The import opened twice for one share

start: A file shared to MettleUp that it cannot take, or a notification naming no page

user_sees: Import screen says 'That file is too big to import (over 50 MB). Export again from Hevy or Strong and share the new file.'
must_not: A crash
A silent nothing

steps.action: Share a file the sending app gave no access to
user_sees: Import screen says 'MettleUp couldn’t open that file. Share it again, or tap “Choose file” and pick it here.'
must_not: An empty import that looks fine

steps.action: Tap a notification whose page name is not a plain app path
user_sees: The app just opens
must_not: Any page outside the app opened

start: No workout open; home screen widget and a workout reminder set for today

user_sees: The widget says 'Resume'
No workout reminder today
must_not: A reminder to train while the workout is open

user_sees: The widget and the reminder go back to normal
The lock-screen card goes away
must_not: The widget still saying 'Resume'
The live card still on the lock screen

steps.action: Open a saved workout to correct it
user_sees: The widget does not say 'Resume'
must_not: A correction of a saved workout counted as an open workout

start: A workout open, phone locked on a table at the gym

steps.action: Someone else looks at the locked phone
user_sees: The live workout card shows the workout's name and timing on the lock screen
must_not: Body weight or notes on the lock screen

steps.action: Tap a notification with a page name from the server
user_sees: Only a page inside MettleUp opens
must_not: A web link or another app opened from a notification
